| **评估依据**：本库 `CYLUtils/CYLComponents/CYLTheme/` 的 10 个源文件（1,885 行）、`CYLTabBarController (CYLTheme)`、示例主题 `UIViewController+CYLThemeSettings.m`，以及 #777 的 CI 结果：25 个单元测试（`CYLThemeTests` 14 个）在 iOS 26 模拟器上运行（撰写本文时，最后一轮修复的运行尚在排队；此前一轮 25 个中 22 个通过，3 个失败项已修正），“Theme screenshots” workflow 在液态玻璃与扁平样式下各截图 6 张，全部无异常。QMUI 一侧依据其公开 API 与源码（`QMUIThemeManager`、`UIColor/UIImage/UIVisualEffect+QMUITheme`、`UIView+QMUITheme`）的设计；未逐行比对版本，涉及其内部实现的描述以“据我们所知”为准。 | **Basis**: the 10 source files (1,885 lines) of `CYLUtils/CYLComponents/CYLTheme/`, `CYLTabBarController (CYLTheme)`, the demo themes in `UIViewController+CYLThemeSettings.m`, and the CI results of #777: 25 unit tests (14 in `CYLThemeTests`) on an iOS 26 simulator (when this was written, the run of the last fixes was still queued; the previous run passed 22 of 25, and the 3 failures were fixed), and the "Theme screenshots" workflow with 6 screenshots each in Liquid Glass and FlatDesign, all without defects. On QMUI's side, the design of its public API and sources (`QMUIThemeManager`, `UIColor/UIImage/UIVisualEffect+QMUITheme`, `UIView+QMUITheme`); versions were not compared line by line, so statements about its internals are to the best of our knowledge. |

## [CN]差距与改进措施
## [EN]Gaps and how to close them

| 差距 / Gap | 现状 / Now | QMUI | 改进 / Improvement | 代价 / Cost |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 图片不是动态对象 / Images are not dynamic | `cyl_imageWithThemeProvider:` 返回当前主题的副本并记住 provider；主题切换时由遍历替换。切换前创建、之后才赋值的图片显示旧主题 / returns a copy of the current theme's image that remembers the provider; the walk swaps it on a change. An image made before a change and assigned after shows the old theme | 代理对象每次使用时解析当前主题 / a proxy resolves the current theme at every use | 增加可选的动态图片：`UIImage` 子类重写 `CGImage`、`size`、`scale`、`imageOrientation`、`renderingMode` 与绘制方法，转发到当前主题的图片；默认仍返回普通副本（与 UIKit 缓存、`isKindOfClass:` 兼容），需要时选用 / add an optional dynamic image: a `UIImage` subclass that overrides `CGImage`, `size`, `scale`, `imageOrientation`, `renderingMode` and the drawing methods and forwards to the current theme's image; the plain copy stays the default (safe with UIKit caches and `isKindOfClass:`), the dynamic one is opt-in | 中 / medium |
| layer 颜色需显式 API / Layer colors need an explicit API | `cyl_setThemeColor:forKeyPath:` 记录 `UIColor`，切换时重设 `CGColor` / records the `UIColor`, resets the `CGColor` on a change | hook setter 自动记录 / swizzled setters record it | 保持无 hook；补两点：1. 深色模式单独变化（主题未变）时也重解析 layer 颜色：管理器在 `updateThemeForTraitCollection:` 中即使 identifier 未变也发起一次“只刷新 layer 颜色”的遍历；2. 文档给出 `traitCollectionDidChange:` 中调用 `cyl_refreshThemeColors` 的写法 / keep it hook-free; add two things: 1. resolve layer colors again when only Dark Mode changes (same theme): the manager starts a "layer colors only" walk from `updateThemeForTraitCollection:` even when the identifier is unchanged; 2. document calling `cyl_refreshThemeColors` from `traitCollectionDidChange:` | 小 / small |
| 两次遍历都不覆盖的视图 / Views in neither walk | App 自己持有、尚未加入控制器的视图，复用队列中的 cell：颜色在绘制时正确，图片 / 效果 / layer 颜色等到下一次切换 / views the app keeps outside any view controller, cells in a reuse queue: colors draw right, images / effects / layer colors wait for the next change | hook `didMoveToWindow` 等 / hooks such as `didMoveToWindow` | 提供 `-[UIView cyl_applyCurrentTheme]`（对自身与子视图执行一次回调，所有管理器），并在文档中建议在自定义视图的 `didMoveToWindow` 与 cell 的 `prepareForReuse` 中调用；可选：`UITableView` / `UICollectionView` 的注册 cell 由库在 `cellForRow` 之后补调（通过 `UITableViewCell+CYLBadgeExtention` 已有的扩展点，无需 hook）/ add `-[UIView cyl_applyCurrentTheme]` (the callback once, for every manager, on the view and its subviews) and document calling it from a custom view's `didMoveToWindow` and a cell's `prepareForReuse`; optionally the library calls it for cells through the existing `UITableViewCell+CYLBadgeExtention` extension point, with no hook | 小 / small |
| 网络图标失败的回退 / Fallback of a failed network icon | 该 Tab 保留上一主题的图标 / the tab keeps the previous theme's icon | 不适用 / n/a | 下载失败时恢复该 Tab 主题前的图标（`originalProviders` 中已有）/ restore the tab's pre-theme icon (already in `originalProviders`) when the download fails | 小 / small |
| SF Symbol 变为位图 / SF Symbols become bitmaps | 副本保留渲染模式，但失去符号配置的动态性（粗细随字体）/ the copy keeps the rendering mode but not the symbol's dynamic configuration | 代理保留 / a proxy keeps it | 对 `isSymbolImage` 为 YES 的图片，用 `imageByApplyingSymbolConfiguration:` 得到新对象而不是位图 / for `isSymbolImage` images, make the new object with `imageByApplyingSymbolConfiguration:` instead of a bitmap | 小 / small |
| 成熟度 / Maturity | 仅模拟器 CI；真机、iOS 15–18、iPad 多窗口未验证 / simulator CI only; no device, iOS 15–18 or multi-window iPad runs | 多年生产 / years of production | 在 CI 矩阵中加入 iOS 18 / 17 运行时（`scripts/unit-tests.sh` 已支持按名称选择模拟器）；发布一个版本后在示例 App 中收集反馈 / add iOS 18 / 17 runtimes to the CI matrix (`scripts/unit-tests.sh` can pick a simulator by name); ship a release and collect feedback from the example app | 中 / medium |

## [CN]与最初架构设计的对照
## [EN]Against the original architecture

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 最初的设计有五条：1. 基础换肤 API 参考 QMUI 的管理器设计（同名、同语义），便于迁移；2. TabBar 通过 `CYLTabBarTheme` 协议原地换肤，不新建 TabBar、不重建页面；3. 换肤的底层复用示例中“更换 Tab 标题”“批量使用本地图标”“下载网络图标”“批量下载网络图标”行所用的库方法，而不是另写一套；4. 不 hook 任何 UIKit 方法；5. 液态玻璃、系统 TabBar、扁平样式一致。 | The original design had five points: 1. the base API follows QMUI's manager design (same names and semantics) to ease migration; 2. the tab bar restyles in place through the `CYLTabBarTheme` protocol, with no new tab bar and no rebuilt pages; 3. the skin's mechanisms are the library methods behind the demo rows "change tab title", "change all local icons", "download network icon" and "change all network icons", not a second implementation; 4. no UIKit method is hooked; 5. Liquid Glass, the system tab bar and FlatDesign behave the same. |

| 设计点 / Design point | 符合度 / Fit | 依据 / Evidence | 备注 / Remarks |
|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| 1. QMUI 风格的管理器 API / QMUI-style manager API | ✅ 完全 / full | `CYLThemeManager` 与 `CYLThemeManagerCenter` 的属性和方法与 QMUI 一一对应，含 `identifierForTrait`、后台截图防抖、`didBecomeActive` 复查 / properties and methods map one to one, including `identifierForTrait`, the background snapshot guard and the `didBecomeActive` recheck | 迁移成本为改前缀 / migration is a prefix change |
| 2. 协议原地换肤 / In-place skins through the protocol | ✅ 完全 / full | `cyl_applyTabBarTheme:` 只修改现有 TabBar 的 appearance、标题、图标视图与 PlusButton；`testTabBarThemeAppliesAndRestoresTheAppearance`、`testTabBarThemeIcons…` / changes only the existing tab bar's appearance, titles, icon views and plus button; the two tests named | 四个可选方法 / four optional methods |
| 3. 复用示例行的底层实现 / Reuse of the demo rows' mechanisms | ✅ 完全 / full | 标题 → `-updateTabBarItemsWithAttributes:`；图标 → `-setTabBarItemIcon:selectedIcon:size:atIndex:`（含网络）；PlusButton → `-updatePlusButtonWithAttributes:` / titles → `-updateTabBarItemsWithAttributes:`; icons → `-setTabBarItemIcon:selectedIcon:size:atIndex:` (network included); plus button → `-updatePlusButtonWithAttributes:` | 第一版用 `tabBarItem.image`，液态玻璃上被 Lottie 覆盖，已改正 / the first version wrote `tabBarItem.image`, covered by Lottie on Liquid Glass, now corrected |
| 4. 不 hook UIKit / No UIKit hooks | ✅ 完全 / full | 全部通过管理器的遍历与控制器回调；`CYLTheme/` 中没有 `method_exchangeImplementations` / everything goes through the manager's walk and the view controller callback; no `method_exchangeImplementations` in `CYLTheme/` | 代价见“自动刷新” / the cost is in "automatic refresh" |
| 5. 三种样式一致 / Three styles alike | ✅ 基本 / mostly | 截图 workflow 两种样式各 6 张；图标视图覆盖液态玻璃选中图层 / the screenshot workflow covers both styles; icon views cover the Liquid Glass selected layer | 系统 TabBar（iOS 18 以前的经典样式）只有单元测试，没有截图 / the system tab bar (classic style before iOS 18) has unit tests but no screenshots |

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 结论：代码符合最初设计。两处偏离都是实现层面的、已修正的错误（`tabBarItem.image` 与 UIKit 的图片缓存），不是设计偏离。设计本身未预料到的两点：主题可以修改的内容在三处（Tab attributes、图标 provider、PlusButton 三部分）各有一套“保存原值 → 应用 → 恢复（除非 App 改过）”逻辑，是同一模式的三次实现；示例主题与 54 个节日图标（134 KB）编译进了库本身而不是示例。 | Conclusion: the code matches the original design. The two deviations were implementation bugs since fixed (`tabBarItem.image`, UIKit's image cache), not design deviations. Two things the design did not foresee: the three kinds of content a theme changes (tab attributes, icon providers, the plus button's three parts) each carry their own "keep the original → apply → restore unless the app changed it" logic, the same pattern written three times; and the demo themes with their 54 holiday icons (134 KB) are compiled into the library rather than the examples. |

## [CN]质量维度评估
## [EN]Quality dimensions

| 维度 / Dimension | 得分 / Score (10) | 评价 / Assessment | 改进 / Improvement |
|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| 兼容性 / Compatibility | 8 | iOS 12+：iOS 13 以前颜色为静态值并在切换时更新；`UITabBarAppearance` 缺失时由 `-cyl_customizeTabBarController:` 补；多 scene 与无 scene 的 window 都遍历；Swift 可用（`__kindof` block 参数）。扣分：主题图片 / 效果的 Swift 命名未加 `NS_SWIFT_NAME`；iOS 15–18 未在 CI 运行 / iOS 12+: static colors before iOS 13, updated on a change; `-cyl_customizeTabBarController:` covers the missing `UITabBarAppearance`; windows with and without scenes are walked; usable from Swift (`__kindof` block parameters). Minus: no `NS_SWIFT_NAME` on the image / effect APIs; iOS 15–18 not in CI | 补 `NS_SWIFT_NAME`；CI 矩阵加 iOS 18 / 17 运行时 / add `NS_SWIFT_NAME`; add iOS 18 / 17 runtimes to CI |
| 健壮性 / Robustness | 7 | 异步图标有代计数（期间切换主题即丢弃）；原值按子控制器弱引用保存；后台截图不触发切换；共享图片不被标记。扣分：无主线程断言；管理器的数组无锁；网络失败回退不理想；`-cyl_applyTabBarTheme:` 未在 `viewWillAppear` 之前调用时首次主题延后到显示时（设计如此，但未文档化边界）/ async icons carry a generation counter (dropped when the theme changes meanwhile); originals are kept per view controller, weakly; background snapshots do not switch; shared images are never marked. Minus: no main thread assertion; the manager's arrays are unlocked; the network failure fallback; the first theme waits for `viewWillAppear` (by design, but the edge is undocumented) | `NSAssert(NSThread.isMainThread)` 在 `setCurrentThemeIdentifier:`；失败回退；文档化首次应用时机 / assert the main thread in `setCurrentThemeIdentifier:`; the failure fallback; document when the first theme applies |
| 扩展性 / Extensibility | 7 | 协议全部可选，新主题只需实现需要的方法；多管理器、generator；新的可跟随主题的对象类型（颜色、图片、效果、layer 颜色）各自独立。扣分：给主题增加一种新内容（例如角标颜色）需要修改 `cyl_applyTabBarTheme:` 并再写一套恢复逻辑，不符合开闭原则 / all protocol methods optional; several managers; generators; each themed object kind stands alone. Minus: a new kind of content a theme can change (e.g. badge colors) needs a change in `cyl_applyTabBarTheme:` and another restore implementation, against the open–closed principle | 见下方“统一恢复模型” / see "one restore model" below |
| 依赖反转 / Dependency inversion | 9 | 方向正确：`CYLUtils/CYLTheme` 不知道 TabBar；`CYLTabBarController`（Core）依赖 Utils，并通过重写 `cyl_themeDidChangeByManager:` 接入；主题对象对引擎是不透明的，TabBar 只依赖 `CYLTabBarTheme` 抽象。扣分：`CYLTabBarTheme` 的 `UITabBarAppearance` 方法把 UIKit 类型暴露给主题对象（可接受）/ the direction is right: `CYLUtils/CYLTheme` knows nothing of the tab bar; Core depends on Utils and plugs in by overriding `cyl_themeDidChangeByManager:`; theme objects are opaque to the engine and the tab bar depends only on the `CYLTabBarTheme` abstraction. Minus: the `UITabBarAppearance` method exposes a UIKit type to themes (acceptable) | — |
| 解耦 / Decoupling | 6 | 引擎与 TabBar 解耦良好；示例主题、设置分组、Tab 更新行（共 3,511 行）与 134 KB 图标编译进库的 Core 与资源包，App 即使不用也要带着；`UIViewController+CYLThemeSettings` 依赖 `CYLTabBarController.h` 全部 API。与仓库既有做法（`UIViewController+CYLSettingsSection` 也在库中）一致，但代价真实存在 / the engine and the tab bar are well separated; the demo themes, the settings section and the item update rows (3,511 lines) and 134 KB of icons are compiled into Core and its resource bundle, carried by every app; `UIViewController+CYLThemeSettings` depends on the whole `CYLTabBarController.h`. Consistent with the repository's existing practice (`UIViewController+CYLSettingsSection` is in the library too), but the cost is real | 新建可选 subspec `CYLTabBarController/Demo`（或移到 `Example-Shared/`），图标随之移出资源包 / a new optional subspec `CYLTabBarController/Demo` (or `Example-Shared/`), the icons leaving the resource bundle with it |
| 性能 / Performance | 8 | 切换时遍历所有 window 的视图树一次（与 QMUI 相同）；颜色每次绘制调用 provider（与 QMUI 相同）；图片副本按位图复制，大图有一次性开销 / one walk of every window's view tree per change (as QMUI); the color provider runs at every draw (as QMUI); image copies are bitmap copies, a one-time cost for large images | 大图可改为仅复制包装对象（`imageWithCGImage:` 共享位图，已是如此）/ large images already share the bitmap through `imageWithCGImage:` |
| 可测试性 / Testability | 8 | 管理器、颜色、图片、效果、layer、不在 window 上的视图、TabBar 主题都有单元测试；CI 运行；截图 workflow。扣分：PlusButton 的主题部分与网络图标无单元测试 / managers, colors, images, effects, layers, off-window views and tab bar themes have unit tests; CI runs them; a screenshot workflow. Minus: no unit tests for the plus button parts and network icons | 用本地文件 URL 测网络路径；PlusButton 恢复测试 / test the network path with file URLs; a plus button restore test |

## [CN]新的建议
## [EN]New proposals

| 优先级 / Priority | 建议 / Proposal | 理由 / Why | 做法 / How |
|:---:|:---|:---|:---|
| P1 | 统一恢复模型 / One restore model | 三处恢复逻辑重复，是本次开发中出错最多的地方（两次 CI 失败都在这里附近）/ the three restore implementations are where most of this work's bugs were (both CI failures sat next to them) | 引入 `CYLThemeRestorableValue`：`capture(current) → apply(themeValue) → restore()`，带“App 期间修改则放弃”与代计数；Tab attributes、图标 provider、PlusButton 三部分都改为该类型的实例；新内容只需新增一个实例 / add `CYLThemeRestorableValue` with `capture(current) → apply(themeValue) → restore()`, the "dropped if the app changed it" rule and the generation counter; tab attributes, icon providers and the plus button's three parts become instances of it; a new kind of content is one more instance |
| P1 | 示例代码移出库 / Demo code out of the library | 解耦分 6；每个 App 多带 134 KB 图标与 3,511 行示例 / decoupling scores 6; every app carries 134 KB of icons and 3,511 lines of demo code | 可选 subspec `Demo`（`UIViewController+CYLThemeSettings`、`+CYLSettingsSection`、`+CYLTabBarItemUpdate`、`cyl_theme_*.png`），示例 Podfile 引用它；SPM 为 `CYLTabBarControllerDemo` target / an optional `Demo` subspec with those three files and the icons, used by the examples' Podfiles; an SPM target `CYLTabBarControllerDemo` |
| P2 | 可选的动态图片 / Opt-in dynamic images | 补齐与 QMUI 的最后 2 分功能差距，同时不改变默认行为 / closes the last 2 functional points to QMUI without changing the default | `+cyl_dynamicImageWithThemeProvider:` 返回 `UIImage` 子类；文档说明其限制（`isKindOfClass:`、与 `UIImageView` 动画的兼容）/ `+cyl_dynamicImageWithThemeProvider:` returns a `UIImage` subclass; document its limits |
| P2 | 深色模式单独变化时刷新 layer 颜色 / Refresh layer colors on a Dark Mode change alone | 当前只在主题切换时重解析 `CGColor` / `CGColor` is resolved again only on a theme change | 管理器在 trait 变化但 identifier 不变时发起“仅 layer”的遍历；或在 `-[UIView cyl_themeDidChangeByManager:…]` 之外增加 `cyl_traitCollectionDidChange` 入口供 App 调用 / a "layers only" walk from the manager when the trait changes but the identifier does not; or an entry point `cyl_traitCollectionDidChange` for apps to call |
| P2 | `-[UIView cyl_applyCurrentTheme]` | 覆盖两次遍历都不到的视图，仍不 hook / reaches the views neither walk covers, still without hooks | 对自身与子视图执行所有管理器的回调；文档给出 `didMoveToWindow` 与 `prepareForReuse` 的用法 / the callback of every manager on the view and its subviews; document `didMoveToWindow` and `prepareForReuse` |
| P3 | 主线程断言与并发说明 / Main thread assertion and concurrency note | 与 QMUI 相同的隐含约定应显式化 / the implicit rule shared with QMUI should be explicit | `NSAssert` + 头文件说明 / an `NSAssert` and a header note |
| P3 | 当前主题持久化 / Persisting the current theme | 示例自己写 `NSUserDefaults`，每个 App 都要重复 / the demo writes `NSUserDefaults` itself; every app repeats it | 管理器可选属性 `persistsCurrentThemeIdentifier`（key 含管理器名）/ an optional manager property `persistsCurrentThemeIdentifier` (key includes the manager name) |
| P3 | 切换过渡动画 / A transition animation | QMUI 也没有；体验加分 / QMUI lacks it too; a visible improvement | 切换前对 window 截图、覆盖、淡出（`UIView transitionWithView:`）/ snapshot the window, overlay it and fade it out |
| P3 | SF Symbol 保留配置 / Keep SF Symbol configurations | 见差距表 / see the gap table | `imageByApplyingSymbolConfiguration:` |
| P3 | 网络图标失败回退 / Network icon failure fallback | 见差距表 / see the gap table | 失败时恢复 `originalProviders` 中的图标 / restore the icon in `originalProviders` on failure |

## [EN]After the refactor

| 本节记录按上方建议进行的改造（#777 中“refactor”提交之后）。除标注外，新行为均有单元测试，由 CI 的 “Unit tests” job 在 iOS 26 模拟器上运行；撰写时该次运行尚未完成，结果见 #777。 | This section records the refactor that followed the proposals above (the "refactor" commit in #777 and after). Unless noted, the new behavior has unit tests, run by the CI job "Unit tests" on an iOS 26 simulator; that run had not finished when this was written, see #777 for its result. |

| 建议 / Proposal | 状态 / Status | 做法 / What changed | 测试 / Test |
|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| P1 统一恢复模型 / One restore model | ✅ | 私有类 `CYLThemeRestorableValue`（保存原值 → App 修改则改为恢复 App 的值 → 恢复）取代三套实现；Tab attributes 改为按 Tab、按 key 恢复，主题添加而 App 原本没有的 key 会被移除（此前会残留）；三者共用一个主题代计数 / a private `CYLThemeRestorableValue` (keep the original → adopt an app change → restore) replaces the three implementations; tab attributes are restored per tab and key, and a key the theme added that the app did not have is removed (it used to stay); one theme generation counter for all three | `testRestoreRemovesAKeyTheAppDidNotHave`、`testRestoreKeepsATitleTheAppChangedMeanwhile` |
| P1 示例代码移出库 / Demo code out of the library | ⏸ 待决定 / needs a decision | 与 CLAUDE.md 冲突：示例 Podfile 不得修改（默认 subspec 为 `Core`，示例代码移出 `Core` 即需修改），公开 API 不得移除（显式依赖 `CYLTabBarController/Core` 的 App 会失去这些头文件）。可选方案见下 / conflicts with CLAUDE.md: the examples' Podfiles must not change (the default subspec is `Core`; moving the demo code out of it needs a Podfile change), and public API must not be removed (apps that depend on `CYLTabBarController/Core` explicitly would lose these headers). Options below | — |
| P2 可选的动态图片 / Opt-in dynamic images | ❌ 已撤回 / withdrawn | 实现为 `UIImage` 子类（重写公开属性与绘制方法，转发到当前主题的图片）后，CI 的离屏渲染测试表明：`UIImageView` 绘制的是图片创建时的内部位图，而不是重写的 `CGImage` 等属性；切换后仍显示旧主题，切换后才赋值也是如此。即不 hook `-[UIImageView setImage:]`（QMUI 的做法）就无法让视图跟随，这样的 API 会误导使用者，因此在发布前移除。图片仍使用当前主题的普通副本（`+cyl_imageWithThemeProvider:`）/ built as a `UIImage` subclass (public properties and drawing methods overridden to forward to the current theme's image), the CI off-screen render test showed that `UIImageView` draws the internal bitmap captured when the image was created, not the overridden `CGImage` and other properties: after a switch it still showed the old theme, also when assigned after the switch. Without hooking `-[UIImageView setImage:]` (what QMUI does) views cannot follow, and such an API would mislead, so it was removed before release. Images stay plain copies of the current theme (`+cyl_imageWithThemeProvider:`) | 渲染测试的结果记录在 #777 的 CI 中 / the render test's result is in #777's CI |
| P2 深色模式下刷新 layer 颜色 / Layer colors on a Dark Mode change | ✅ | `+[CYLThemeManagerCenter updateThemesForTraitCollection:]`（`CYLTabBarController` 在外观变化时调用）在没有主题切换时重新解析所有 window 与不在 window 上的控制器视图中的 layer 颜色 / `+[CYLThemeManagerCenter updateThemesForTraitCollection:]` (called by `CYLTabBarController` on an appearance change) resolves the layer colors of every window and of off-window view controller views again when no theme switched | 无（需改变模拟器外观）/ none (needs the simulator's appearance to change) |
| P2 `-[UIView cyl_applyCurrentTheme]` | ✅ | 对视图及其子视图执行所有管理器的刷新与回调 / the refresh and callbacks of every manager on the view and its subviews | `testApplyCurrentThemeRefreshesAViewNothingWalked` |
| P3 主线程断言 / Main thread assertion | ✅ | `setCurrentThemeIdentifier:` 与 `setCurrentTheme:` 中的 `NSAssert` / an `NSAssert` in both setters | — |
| P3 主题持久化 / Persisting the theme | ✅ | `persistsCurrentThemeIdentifier`：保存到 `NSUserDefaults`（key 含管理器名），设为 YES 时或之后注册该主题时恢复 / saved in `NSUserDefaults` (key includes the manager name), restored when set to YES or when the theme is registered later | `testPersistsCurrentThemeIdentifier` |
| P3 切换过渡动画 / Transition animation | ✅ | `themeChangeAnimationDuration`：每个可见 window 覆盖截图，更新后淡出 / a snapshot over each visible window, faded out after the restyle | 无（视觉效果）/ none (visual) |
| P3 SF Symbol 保留配置 / Keep SF Symbols | ✅ | `imageByApplyingSymbolConfiguration:` 返回新对象时保留为符号，否则回退为位图 / kept a symbol when `imageByApplyingSymbolConfiguration:` returns a new object, else a bitmap | `testSymbolThemeImagesAreMarkedNewObjects`（是否仍为符号记录在日志中 / whether it stays a symbol is logged） |
| P3 网络图标失败回退 / Network icon failure fallback | ✅ | 图标或 PlusButton 图片加载失败时恢复主题前的内容 / a tab icon or plus button image that fails to load gets its pre-theme value back | 无（需网络失败）/ none (needs a failing download) |

## [CN]结论
## [EN]Conclusion

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 本次实现达到了最初的设计：QMUI 风格的管理器、协议驱动的原地换肤、复用示例行的底层方法、无 hook、三种样式一致。功能上已超过 QMUI 的主题模块（81 对 74），总分持平（84 对 83），差距只剩成熟度。按建议改造后（见上一节）总分为 87（功能分 84）。剩余差距：图片不是代理对象（不 hook 无法实现，已用 CI 验证）、示例代码移出库（需决定方案）与成熟度。 | The implementation meets the original design: a QMUI-style manager, protocol-driven in-place skins, the demo rows' mechanisms reused, no hooks, three styles alike. Functionally it is now ahead of QMUI's theme module (81 to 74) and level overall (84 to 83); what remains is maturity. After the refactor that followed the proposals (previous section) the total is 87 (84 functional). What remains: images are not proxies (impossible without hooks, verified in CI), the demo code out of the library (a decision is needed), and maturity. |
